description: This Dart file defines a PaymentService class that simulates a payment process for an event and ticket booking application. It includes a mock implementation of payment, intended to be replaced with Stripe integration when API keys are available.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: A mock payment service class intended for integration with Stripe or other payment providers in the future. Contains a method to simulate payment processing.

methods.name: pay
methods.description: Simulates a successful payment process, returning a mock payment intent ID after a delay.
